messages:
Maya: Heads up — we got a spike in S3 egress costs tied to the audit-logs bucket after last night's KMS key rotation. Cloud billing alerted ~ $1.2k extra.
Tom: Seen the alert too. Any idea which region's traffic?
Maya: Mostly eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 KMS calls for encrypting logs. GPUs in eu-west -> logs in us-east bucket now failover route via NAT.
Sasha: Wait — why are eu-west nodes calling us-east KMS? I thought we set multi-region keys last quarter.
Maya: Key in us-east is still primary for audit-logs bucket. We rotated but didn't create MR key. Result: cross-region requests + NAT egress.
Jacob: Also noticed firewall egress rule tightened yesterday — it blocked direct S3 VPC endpoint traffic, forced traffic through NAT.
Irene: That explains both failures and extra cost. Can we add an S3 Gateway endpoint in eu-west and replicate key or create MR key?
Tom: Prefer S3 endpoint + local KMS MR key. S3 endpoint avoids NAT charges, MR KMS avoids cross-region API calls.
Maya: Agreed. Quick plan: 1) create KMS multi-region replica in eu-west (I can do). 2) Add S3 gateway endpoint for audit bucket in VPCs (Infra team). 3) Update IAM policy for kms:Encrypt on replica key. 4) Open firewall egress to KMS endpoint in eu-west only.
Sasha: IAM changes need review — ensure key policy restricts to infra service account and audit-bot role. Also rotate alias to point to replica?
Jacob: firewall rule change request submitted: PR#452 in tf-mods. It's currently set to deny 443 outbound except allowlist; adding kms.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com and s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com.
InfraBot: deploy started for tf-mods PR#452 — plan shows adding aws_vpc_endpoint.s3-audit and security_group changes.
Irene: Action — Maya to create MR KMS by EOD, Jacob to merge PR after tests, Tom to verify logs successful and cost baseline tomorrow.
Maya: Creating MR key now: cli snippet
```
aws kms create-replica-key --primary-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 --region eu-west-1
```
Tom: After MR key exists we need to update bucket encryption to use the eu-west key for objects written from eu-west. Might be an alias switch per producer.
Sasha: I'll review IAM policy. Make sure CloudTrail uses original principal for audit — avoid breaking cross-account logging.
Jacob: FYI this also impacted GPU provisioning — several jobs failed to upload logs to audit bucket and got retried, causing slurm backlog. We saw ~12% GPU backlog for 2h.
Maya: Noted. We'll add a temporary fallback: send minimal logs to local ephemeral storage and a periodic bulk upload once endpoint fixed.
Irene: Setting meeting 11:30 to confirm roll-out. @Maya @Jacob @Tom @Sasha please join. :thumbsup: 
Audit-bot: Incident closed? No, monitoring continues — metric: s3.e2e_upload_failures spiked 2026-03-18T02:12Z.
Maya: Adding postmortem doc draft to #incidents after change.
Tom: Sounds good. Thanks team.
